title: Turn Physical Reality into Your Digital Key
description: No tedious passwords to remember, no screenshot leaks to worry about. Powered by client-side ORB feature extraction and server-side RANSAC homography geometric verification, VisionPass enables zero-knowledge physical visual credentials.

features.title: Three Core Pillars
features.subtitle: Bridging Trust Between Physical and Digital Realities
features.f1Desc: Use artwork, book covers, custom figurines, or physical textures as the unique hardware key. Cannot be decrypted by textual sharing alone.
features.f2Desc: Image decoding and ORB descriptor extraction run 100% inside client Web Workers. Servers only receive compact math vectors, never raw images.
features.f3Desc: Self-hosted domain + Human-readable Passcode + RANSAC geometric homography inliers (>= 12). All three factors required to unlock.

techHighlights.title: Robust Full-Stack Architecture & Production Standards
techHighlights.subtitle: Stateless, zero C++/Python runtime tech stack designed specifically for Serverless and multi-device platforms.
techHighlights.tanstackDesc: React 19 + Nitro + Vite with type-safe isomorphic createServerFn communication.
techHighlights.opencvDesc: Web Worker thread isolation keeps UI thread at a silky smooth 60 FPS.
techHighlights.pureTsDesc: Gaussian elimination homography & Hamming bitwise operations with sub-5ms latency.
techHighlights.aeadDesc: HMAC-salted token index, encrypted at rest, decrypted in-memory only upon geometric inlier verification.

useCases.title: Explore Endless Possibilities
useCases.subtitle: REAL WORLD USE CASES
useCases.case1Desc: Players must visit actual exhibits or physical landmarks to take photos and unlock the next classified clue.
useCases.case2Desc: Use security seals or bespoke stamps as physical keys to prevent unauthorized receipt or remote spoofing.
useCases.case3Desc: Transform cherished commemorative items (such as photo frames or watches) into the unique digital key to private messages.

workflow.title: Streamlined & Robust Workflow
workflow.subtitle: From a physical anchor to millisecond real-time unlocking
workflow.step1Desc: Select a textured physical object and enter the confidential secret message.
workflow.step2Desc: OpenCV.js WASM extracts up to 500 ORB keypoints and 32-byte binary descriptors in the browser.
workflow.step3Desc: Generate a shareable poster with draggable QR overlay. The QR code encodes only the Passcode.
workflow.step4Desc: The recipient scans the code and aligns the camera with the object. RANSAC verifies geometry and reveals the secret instantly.

cta.title: Ready to Experience VisionPass?
cta.subtitle: No sign-up required, 100% open source. Experience spatial mathematical collisions and secure visual decryption in the Playground.
